export KLEE_HOME=/usr/local
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
export CPATH="/usr/local/include${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export LLVM_CONFIG=/usr/bin/llvm-config-16
export KLEE_RUNTIME_DIR=/usr/local/lib/klee/runtime
EOF
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/klee.sh; sh -c '. /etc/profile.d/klee.sh; echo CPATH=$CPATH; command -v klee'

summary:
bash: python3 - <<'EOF'
paths = ["/usr/local/include", "/usr/local/include/klee"]
block = """# --- KLEE 3.4-pre (LLVM 16 + STP) ---
export KLEE_HOME=/usr/local
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
export CPATH="/usr/local/include:/usr/local/include/klee${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export LLVM_CONFIG=/usr/bin/llvm-config-16
export KLEE_RUNTIME_DIR=/usr/local/lib/klee/runtime
# --- end KLEE ---
"""
# replace in profile.d
open("/etc/profile.d/klee.sh","w").write(block)
# replace the whole old block in .bashrc
old = open("/root/.bashrc").read()
start = old.index("# --- KLEE")
end = old.index("# --- end KLEE ---") + len("# --- end KLEE ---\n")
new = old[:start] + block + old[end:]
open("/root/.bashrc","w").write(new)
EOF
head -10 /root/.bashrc; echo "=== syntax:"; bash -n /root/.bashrc && echo ok
